text:
chao: CI for hosted-integ is red on the auth+streaming+toolcall matrix after landing rfc/kv-cache-fix (PR #8421). failing tests: auth_refresh_flow.test, streaming_ordering.test, toolcall_schema.test. logs show 401s + truncated stream frames.

maria: ack. can you paste the failing stack/log snippet?

chao: sure, from the hosted-integ shard 7:
```
E 00:13:42 auth: token refresh failed, status=401, body={\"error\":\"invalid_grant\"}
E 00:13:43 stream: dropped frame seq 12 (expected 13)
E 00:13:43 toolcall: validation error: got field \"action\" but schema expects \"tool_action\"
```

liam: interesting — auth 401 suggests a token audience mismatch. the kv-cache change touched runtime auth header propagation? could be a header rewrite bug.

olivia: toolcall schema mismatch might be a downstream contract change in the test harness. but combined with streaming frame reorder feels like a runtime patch affected serialization ordering.

chao: running a local repro now, but wanted to ask for a quick CI rerun on that shard. pinging @devbot to queue rerun. if it's flaky we can avoid bisect.

devbot: rerun queued for pipeline hosted-integ (shard 7) by @chao — build 1912345600 -> rerun 1912345679. status: queued.

maria: while it's queued, can someone try a minimal curl against the hosted test endpoint to reproduce the 401? e.g.
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://hosted-api.test.internal/v1/generate
```

liam: @chao can you confirm which commit range to bisect if rerun is red? last green on our tracking board is commit abc1234 (2029-01-15). suspect range abc1234..def5678 (includes PR #8421).

chao: yep suspect range is abc1234..def5678. if rerun fails I'll ask SRE to bisect across that range. also leaving notes: streaming repro uses sequence length 2048 and small chunk_size=256 to trigger chunking.

sre-bot: bisect request received: target=hosted-integ, range=abc1234..def5678, tests=[auth_refresh_flow.test,streaming_ordering.test,toolcall_schema.test]. assigned to oncall: liam. ETA 5m to start.

olivia: quick thought — PR #8421 introduced a change in the http-client header normalization. maybe Authorization header capitalization now normalized to lowercase, and our auth backend expects "Authorization" exact-case in integration tests. gross, but possible.

liam: starting bisect run now. I'll post failing commit if found. if it's a false positive flaky CI we'll abort.

devbot: rerun started: job 1912345679 -> running on runner-host-12.

devbot: rerun finished: job 1912345679 -> status: failed. same failing tests.

chao: ok consistent failure. liam — proceed with bisect. I'm attaching the minimal repro script in case you want to run locally:
```
#!/bin/bash
TOKEN=\"$TEST_TOKEN\"
seq=0
while read -r part; do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
    -d '{"prompt":"hello","seq":'$seq'}' \\
    https://hosted-api.test.internal/v1/stream | jq .
  seq=$((seq+1))
done < <(yes | head -n 5)
```

maria: thanks. liam — if bisect pins to a single commit, let's do a quick revert/patch and run an expedited smoke before merging rollback.

liam: bisect in progress... currently testing midpoint commit: def1000. will update with results.

olivia: adding note: if it's header-case, we should also add a regression test to the hosted harness to catch case-insensitive headers from the client runtime.

liam: bisect result: commit def4321 introduced header normalization util that lowercases all header keys. reproduces 401 + toolcall mismatch. marking as culprit.

chao: nice find. sounds like the normalization stepped on tools that rely on case-sensitive JSON keys in tool payloads? we need a fix ASAP.

maria: plan: revert def4321 on main (hotfix), add compatibility layer in http-client to preserve Authorization case, add integration test for streaming framing + toolcall schema. liam, can you open PR for revert+fix and request urgent review? tag @olivia @chao.

liam: will open PR now: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/8499 — marking as hotfix. requesting review from @maria @olivia @chao.

devbot: PR 8499 build started on ci-hotfix-runner.

chao: once merged, can someone trigger a full hosted-integ run (all shards)? I'll monitor.

maria: will trigger after green on hotfix CI. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

liam: merging hotfix now since CI is green on PR 8499. triggering hosted-integ full run.

devbot: hosted-integ full run queued -> job 1912345880.

sre-bot: hosted-integ full run finished: job 1912345880 -> status: success. all tests green.

chao: confirmed. thanks team — closing the loop. we'll follow up with a postmortem note in eng-infra tomorrow with details and test additions.
